envelope.author: architect
envelope.reason: The note skill closed the kind set, a decision C could not derive; C now states where the kinds live. 'Owed ruling' is reserved to the notebook, so no other skill defines it.

payload.gloss: the set of notes: ideas, questions and decisions not yet canonical, the intake that design canonizes. Anyone may capture, revise or retract a note. A note's title is its name, one live note per title. Its kind is one of the note skill's labels (idea, question, decision), which the runtime never interprets. A live note that blocks a plan or unit is an **owed ruling**, the one sense of that sign; it blocks what it names until it no longer does, by being retracted or revised to block nothing, and a diverged note blocks whatever any of its versions blocks until it is reconciled.
